title: SeedSpec authoring pass result
description: Durable state for one authoring review pass. This is authoring workspace state, never part of a distributable SeedSpec package, and it is not protocol conformance surface. The engine writes this file through authoring operations; the schema is published so the contract is inspectable rather than implied.

authoring_result_version.description: Must equal the result format implied by the pass request's authoring_instruction_version.

pass.description: Must equal the pass id in request.yaml, for example 0001-seed.

area.description: Must equal the area in request.yaml.

package_digest_after.description: The package digest when the pass was last written. The engine records this; it is not transcribed by hand.

outcome.description: in-progress and needs-author are non-terminal. reviewed and completed satisfy the area. abandoned and superseded end the pass without satisfying it.

disposition.description: pending while the pass is open. A satisfied pass records how the area was left. good-enough and not-relevant are successful dispositions, not failures.

summary.description: Empty while disposition is pending. A satisfied pass states what changed in product terms. Never a record of process, reading, or tool activity.

findings.description: Grounded concerns triggered by current package content or a declared source. Absence of material is not a finding.

contradictions.description: Two authored claims that cannot both hold.

inventory.description: What the reviewed material actually contains.

suggestions.description: Improvements the author asked for. A declined suggestion creates no future package work.

tooling_feedback.description: Platform gaps hit while authoring. These are engine work items, not package-author decisions.

questions.description: Index of question ids for this pass. Question content is canonical in open-questions.yaml.

commands.description: Commands the engine ran for this pass.

allOf.description: A satisfied pass needs a real summary, a settled disposition, and a valid package.
An open pass keeps summary empty so no process narration accumulates in durable state.
